data.title: Cyclone: red alert Oct 29 for Mulugu, Khammam, Kothagudem, Mahabubabad
data.body: IMD: landfall between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam on Oct 28, gusts up to 140 kmph. Telangana: 4 red and 5 orange districts on Oct 29. Hyderabad: gusty winds 30–40 kmph, no rain alert.

steps.b: Severe cyclonic system 820 km ESE of Visakhapatnam, heading for Andhra.
East Telangana gets heavy to extremely heavy rain on Oct 29.
Landfall Oct 28 morning to early afternoon; watch IMD bulletins.

data.care: Travel to Khammam, Bhadrachalam or Warangal on Oct 28–29? Push it if you can.

data.body: MEMU 66571/66572 off Oct 23–25, Oct 28–Nov 1, Nov 4–7 for Tumakuru yard work; some expresses delayed. Plan buses or other trains.
